metaDescription: Six electric fireplaces at or under $300 compared on heater wattage, size, install type, thermostat and flame controls, with honest notes on zone heat.
expertTake: The Silonn 50 inch smart wall fireplace is the best overall pick because a wide linear flame, a thermostat and app, remote and touch controls give the most complete package at this cap. The Jocoevol TV stand fireplace is the pick for anyone who wants a media console and a fireplace in one piece. Skip an electric fireplace as a primary heat source, because every model here is a 1500 watt zone heater and not a furnace replacement.
introParagraphs: An electric fireplace gives a living room a focal point without a chimney, gas line or ash. The flame is an LED effect, and the heat comes from a small fan heater tucked behind it, so the real job is to choose the form that fits your wall and your habits.

The common mistake is expecting whole-room heat from a flame effect. At this budget the heater is a standard plug-in unit, and the best uses are ambiance and a warm spot near a seat. This guide sorts the options by how they install, how they control heat and flame, and where they fit in a real room.

products.name: Silonn 50 Inch Smart Wall-Mounted or Recessed Electric Fireplace
products.description:
Silonn is an ultra slim 50 inch linear fireplace that mounts on the wall or recesses into it, with a 1500 watt heater, an adjustable thermostat and control from an app, a remote or a touch panel. The flame has 20 colors and a crystal stone bed, with or without heat.

A wide, shallow flame suits a living room wall above a console, and a thermostat cycles the heater to hold a set temperature, which is more efficient than a heater that runs constantly. Compared with the Garvee, the Silonn is a wider and more feature-rich model with app preheating, though the data reviewed does not state the depth. A 50 inch wall unit needs a wall that can bear the weight.

Check whether you want to hardwire or plug in, and keep the heater outlet clear of curtains and furniture. Plan for a dedicated 120 volt circuit when possible. Dust the stone bed and the vents every few months. If you recess it, ask an electrician about running a dedicated outlet inside the wall, since a hidden power point avoids a visible cord and keeps the heater off a crowded circuit.
products.bestFor: Living rooms that want a wide linear flame with a thermostat and app control.
pros: 50 inch linear flame creates a strong focal point above a console
Thermostat and 1500 watt heater hold a set temperature
App, remote and touch panel give three ways to control it
Flame can run without heat for year-round ambiance
cons: Wall mounting or recessing needs a plan and some install work
Heater depth and weight are not stated in the data reviewed

products.name: Jocoevol 58 Inch Farmhouse Electric Fireplace TV Stand for 65 Inch TVs
products.description:
Jocoevol combines a 58 inch farmhouse entertainment center with a built-in electric fireplace and two large storage cabinets, rated for TVs up to 65 inches. The flame is a 3D effect, and the heater is designed to be smoke and ash free.

A fireplace TV stand is the simplest way to add a flame to a room without wall work, because it is just a console that plugs in. The trade is that heat rises, so putting a TV right above a heater can warm the screen. Check that the heater vents point forward, not up. Compared with the VITESSE, the Jocoevol is smaller and more storage-led, and its sliding doors add a farmhouse look.

Assembly takes a couple of hours and two people. Anchor the stand to the wall for safety with a heavy TV. Keep the heater clear of curtains and cords. Run the fireplace on a dedicated outlet where possible, since a heater and a TV on one circuit can trip the breaker. Because the stand is wide and heavy, build it in the room where it will live, and have a second person hold the top panel while you tighten the final screws.
products.bestFor: Living rooms that need a TV console and a fireplace in one piece.
pros: Stand and fireplace combine in one piece for a simple setup
58 inch width supports a TV up to 65 inches
Two large cabinets hide media gear
Farmhouse styling pairs with wood floors and neutral sofas
cons: Heat and a TV above can warm the screen, so check the vent direction
Heavy and bulky, so assembly and delivery need two people

products.name: VITESSE 70 Inch Fireplace TV Stand with 36 Inch LED Electric Fire
products.description:
VITESSE is a 70 inch TV stand with a 36 inch electric fireplace and LED lighting in 20 colors, designed as a two-in-one entertainment center. The listing warns that it ships in two separate packages that may arrive at different times.

A 70 inch console is a big piece, and it suits a large living room where a 65 inch or larger TV sits above it. The 36 inch fireplace insert provides the flame, and the LEDs add color options. Compared with the Jocoevol, the VITESSE is wider, with a bigger fireplace, but the data reviewed does not state the TV size rating or the storage layout. A larger console means more weight and more floor space.

Check the delivery size before ordering, and measure the doorway. Anchor the stand to the wall. Keep the heater vents clear and avoid placing heat-sensitive items on the shelf above. Dust the flame bed and vents regularly. If the LED colors tempt you, pick one warm setting and use it, since rotating colors look gimmicky in a living room and are better kept for parties.
products.bestFor: Large living rooms that want a wide console with a feature fireplace.
pros: 70 inch width supports a large TV and a broad media setup
36 inch fireplace gives a strong flame in a console
20 LED colors offer varied ambiance
Two-in-one design saves buying a separate stand
cons: Ships in two packages that may arrive on different days
TV rating and storage layout are not stated in the data reviewed

products.name: ROVSUN 32 Inch Smart Electric Fireplace Stove with App and Remote
products.description:
ROVSUN offers a 32 inch freestanding electric fireplace with a mantel, app and remote control, a timer and a thermostat that can be adjusted from 62 degrees Fahrenheit. Realistic flames burn above lifelike logs, and the unit is freestanding with no install.

A freestanding fireplace is the easiest to place, because it stands against a wall and plugs in, and the mantel gives you a display shelf. Compared with the Silonn, the ROVSUN is smaller and simpler, with a traditional look, but it takes floor space and the data reviewed does not state a depth. App control is a convenience for preheating, though apps can be unreliable over time.

Place it against a wall with clearance in front and above, and keep curtains and furniture away from the heater outlet. Use a dedicated outlet. Do not rely on the app as the only control, and check the physical buttons. Mantels collect candles and frames, but keep anything flammable away from the sides of the unit where warm air exits, and never drape a stocking over the heater.
products.bestFor: Living rooms that want a traditional mantel look with no installation.
pros: Freestanding design needs no install and moves with you
Mantel provides a display shelf above the fire
App and remote control with a timer and thermostat
Realistic log bed suits a traditional room
cons: Takes floor space compared with a wall-mounted unit
Depth is not stated in the data reviewed

products.name: HOMCOM 26 Inch Electric Fireplace with Mantel and 1400W Insert
products.description:
HOMCOM makes a 26 inch freestanding fireplace with a dark brown mantel surround and a 1400 watt replaceable insert, with a 3D flame effect, temperature control and a timer. The insert can be replaced if the heater fails, which is a useful design detail.

A 26 inch width is the smallest in this guide, and it fits a bedroom corner or a narrow living room wall. The small size limits the heat to a spot near the unit, and a 1400 watt heater is a modest zone heater. Compared with the ROVSUN, the HOMCOM is smaller and lacks app control, but a plain remote and timer are easier to keep working. The data reviewed does not state the depth.

Place it flat on the floor and plug it into a dedicated outlet. Keep it clear of curtains. Wipe the mantel with a dry cloth, and vacuum the vents every few months. Because the insert is replaceable, keep the model number and a photo of the label, so you can find a matching part if the heater ever fails.
products.bestFor: Bedrooms and small living rooms that need a compact freestanding fireplace.
pros: 26 inch width fits a corner or a narrow wall
Replaceable insert means a heater failure need not end the unit
Timer and temperature controls keep it simple
Dark brown mantel suits traditional rooms
cons: Small unit gives only localized heat
No app control in the data reviewed

products.name: Garvee 30 Inch Ultra-Thin Wall-Mounted or Recessed Electric Fireplace
products.description:
Garvee is a 30 inch ultra-thin wall unit that mounts flush or on the wall, with 750 and 1500 watt heat settings, a thermostat from 62 to 82 degrees Fahrenheit and touch or remote controls. The low 750 watt setting maintains warmth gently, and the 1500 watt setting provides faster heat.

A 30 inch slim unit suits a bedroom wall or a small living room, and the two heat levels help avoid tripping a breaker when you share a circuit. Compared with the Silonn, the Garvee is smaller and cheaper but lacks app control, and the flame bed has fewer color options in the data reviewed. A wall mounted unit needs studs and a plan for the cord.

Plan the cord path before mounting, since most units plug into a standard outlet, and a hidden outlet behind the unit is the neatest option. Keep the area above the heater clear. Dust the vents. If the room is cold, run the 1500 watt setting for the first half hour and then drop to 750 watts, which holds the temperature with less draw.
products.bestFor: Bedrooms and small rooms that want a slim, wall-mounted flame with two heat levels.
pros: Two heat levels let you use 750 watts on a shared circuit
Thermostat from 62 to 82 degrees holds a set temperature
Slim wall design saves floor space
Touch panel and remote give two ways to control it
cons: Smaller 30 inch size gives less visual impact than a wide linear unit
Wall mounting needs studs and a cord plan

buyingCriteria.explanation: Freestanding fireplaces like the ROVSUN and HOMCOM need no install. TV stand combos like the Jocoevol and VITESSE are assembled furniture. Wall units like the Silonn and Garvee mount or recess, which needs studs and a cord plan. Pick the type by how much work you will do.

A 1500 watt heater draws about 12.5 amps at 120 volts, which is most of a standard 15 amp circuit. Running it with a TV or another heater on the same circuit can trip the breaker. The Garvee's 750 watt setting helps on a shared circuit. Use a dedicated outlet when you can. Look at the outlet wiring before you buy: older homes often share a circuit across a whole room, and a space heater is the usual cause of a tripped breaker.
A 1500 watt heater is about 5,100 BTU, which is supplemental zone heat for a room of modest size and not whole-house heat. Place the fireplace where you sit, and keep expectations modest.
Flames are LEDs, and they can run without heat. Colors, brightness and ember beds vary. Remote and app controls are convenient, but remotes get lost, so choose a unit with a panel on the body.

Measure the wall, the cavity depth and the surrounding trim. The Silonn is 50 inches wide and the Garvee is 30 inches. A fireplace that is too small looks lost, and one that is too big overwhelms a room. Allow at least 36 inches of clear space in front of any unit, and avoid putting a rug with a long pile where the heater blows.
A $300 cap gives up large flame beds, quiet fans and robust remote systems. It still delivers ambiance and zone heat. For a main living room wall, consider a higher tier.

howWeEvaluated.title: Under cap only
howWeEvaluated.description: Every fireplace here was at or under the cap on its live listing when this guide was updated. Prices move, so recheck before buying. Items above the cap were excluded.

howWeEvaluated.title: Install and size
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared install type and stated widths from 26 to 70 inches. Missing specs are labeled as not stated.

howWeEvaluated.title: Heat and controls
howWeEvaluated.description: We read each listing for wattage, thermostat range and controls. We do not test products.

howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at general themes in owner feedback, such as fan noise and remotes failing. We treat those as patterns, not measurements.

cards.label: Wall unit
cards.text: The Silonn and Garvee save floor space and look modern, but need studs, a cord plan and sometimes a recess.

cards.label: Freestanding
cards.text: The ROVSUN and HOMCOM need no install and move easily, but take floor space.

howToChoose.note: Choose a wall unit for a modern look, and freestanding for a rental or a quick setup.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A freestanding or plug-in unit, no wall work, a 750 watt setting for shared circuits and a size that fits the wall.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The HOMCOM and ROVSUN fit best. Both plug in and need no tools.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want a larger flame bed, quiet operation, a recessed install with trim or a high-end remote system.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: The fireplace is for a bedroom or a small room. The HOMCOM covers the basics.

maintenance.task: Dust the vents and flame bed
maintenance.why: Dust traps heat and dulls the flame. A vacuum brush keeps vents clear.
High-draw heaters warm plugs and cords. Replace anything discolored.
Sensors drift. A quick test confirms the unit shuts off.
Curtains, throws and furniture near the vent are a fire risk. Keep them away.
Weak batteries cause laggy response. Replace before the remote is lost.

faq.q: Can an electric fireplace heat a room?
faq.a: It warms a zone. A 1500 watt unit gives about 5,100 BTU, which suits a small room and not a whole house. A small rug or throw nearby makes the spot feel warmer without raising the heat setting.

faq.q: Do I need a dedicated circuit?
faq.a: It is best. A 1500 watt heater uses most of a 15 amp circuit, so share it with little else.
Prices move. The cap reflects listing prices when this guide was updated, so recheck before buying.
No. It is an LED effect, and it can run without heat for year-round ambiance. Many owners keep the flame on without heat in warm months, which uses very little power.

faq.q: Can I put a TV above one?
faq.a: Only if the heater vents forward. Heat rising from the unit can warm the screen.
Fans produce some noise, and cheaper units are louder. Check owner feedback for the model.
